name: Lens
description: A magnifier that follows the mouse over an image or any content. The real content stays in place and fully accessible; the lens is a hidden, inert enlarged copy that appears only under a real pointer.

children.description: The content to magnify, usually an image with alt text.

size.description: Diameter of the lens in px.

isStill.description: Turns the lens off. Also off for touch and for visitors who prefer reduced motion.

requirements: The lens is decoration for mouse users: it never takes focus and no information may depend on it
The enlarged copy is aria-hidden and inert, so assistive technology reads the child once
The child keeps its own alt text, links and controls exactly as before
Off for touch input, for prefers-reduced-motion and inside rdm-still or with isStill
Keyboard users can still reach everything: zooming the page is the way to magnify for them
Forced-colors: the lens ring uses a system colour
screenReader: The child is announced as usual; the lens is not announced

use_when: Product photos and diagrams where detail matters
Maps and charts with fine print
avoid_when: Content that is only meaningful when enlarged, since not everyone can use a mouse
anti_patterns: Wrapping interactive forms, whose copy would be inert
Using it as the only way to read small text
